Taking skins to meeting place

The hunter wishes to sell his trophies directly to the buyer from the capital, thus cutting out the local merchant. The toadies of the merchant will try to prevent anyone from reaching the tent of the buyer.

Objectives

Find the meeting place

Hang the skins

Karansul's domain
